why_this_addendum_exists: The completed 160/160 matrix and the first Stage A closeout were premature. Causal Butterworth (SIM-P3) is the only generation branch that produces paper-like Fig. 4. The first-review one-factor candidates SIM-P4/P5/P6/P7 and composite SIM-R1 all inherit the original ZERO-PHASE branch, so they do not test whether remaining Fig. 5/6 discrepancies disappear under a coherent CAUSAL reconstruction. These branches were added after observing SIM-P3. They are not ReDisCA ablations. Combinations were declared before seeing their results.

candidates_added.why_necessary_after_SIM-P3: I_c=100 was already a source-supported reading (Fig. 4 panel titles). Testing it only on the now-known-bad zero-phase branch is insufficient.
candidates_added.source: Fig. 4 panel titles vs caption; paper does not print I_c

candidates_added.why_necessary_after_SIM-P3: Literal high-D δ remains unresolved. SIM-P3 recovers Fig. 4 localization but still has weak pattern–topo correlation on Fig. 5/6. The forensic norm-15% reading was previously tested only on zero-phase.
candidates_added.source: Published Σ=σ²I, σ=0.15||g|| vs preprint variance-equal-to-15%-of-norm

candidates_added.why_necessary_after_SIM-P3: Eq. (15)–(16) write a single γ; global RMS scaling was previously crossed only with zero-phase.
Fixed 1000 noise loci vs per-epoch redraw remains a source-supported ambiguity; previously tested only on zero-phase.
One coherent causal composite declared before seeing results. Not a Cartesian product substitute for the one-factor SIM-C* branches. Not tuned after seeing which combo matches paper Fig. 5/6.
candidates_added.source: Same four external ambiguities as SIM-R1, now on the causal Butterworth branch that actually produces paper-like Fig. 4

exact_assumptions.equation_reading: Eq. (16) writes X_c = sum_p (g_true_p + delta_p) s_cp^T + gamma Upsilon_x with no trial index l and no I_c. Text says construction matched the first experiment except P=4, so both the trial-average reading and this single-matrix reading remain open.
exact_assumptions.X_c: one sensor matrix per condition per Monte-Carlo iteration
exact_assumptions.Upsilon_x: newly generated independently per condition (one N×T brain-noise matrix per X_c). Not shared across conditions. Eq. (16) does not index Upsilon_x by c; per-condition generation is the conservative reading of “one matrix per X_c”.
exact_assumptions.C5: generated as the first five conditions of a C=6 draw (same as SIM-P3 / Fig. 6 subset reading). Not C=5-from-scratch.
exact_assumptions.RDM: same theoretical / noisy RDM construction as SIM-P3

candidates_added.why_necessary_after_SIM-P3: Current Python always builds I_c × C noise epochs and averages before ReDisCA. That is only one reading of an equation that has no trial index. Because causal filtering is the only paper-like Fig. 4 branch, the single-matrix reading must be tested on the causal branch.

Source inspection still leaves the δ reading unresolved. Literal Σ=σ²I is pathological in 204-D and SIM-P3 still has weak pattern correlation. This is the coherent causal + Eq. (16) + norm-15% branch, declared before seeing its result.
